title: Custodial Subsidy Account Terms — Interest Rate Buydown
content:
Under the Interest Rate Buydown, the **buydown subsidy balance** is the temporary buydown subsidy held in the custodial account and not yet drawn or refunded, in US dollars. The terms below fix, product by product, where the subsidy is held after closing, how it is drawn, the first payment it supports, what becomes of subsidy left at a payoff or refinance, whether the remaining subsidy follows the loan on an approved assumption, and whether permanent buydown points are refundable after closing.

| Product | Where the subsidy is held after closing | How the subsidy is drawn | First payment the subsidy supports | Subsidy left at payoff or refinance | Remaining subsidy follows the loan on an approved assumption | Permanent buydown points refundable after closing |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 1-0 Temporary Buydown | custodial account | monthly, with the payment | the first payment | credited to the borrower | Yes | No |
| Larkspur 1-1 Temporary Buydown | custodial account | monthly, with the payment | the first payment | credited to the borrower | Yes | No |
| Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown | custodial account | monthly, with the payment | the first payment | credited to the borrower | Yes | No |
| Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown | custodial account | monthly, with the payment | the first payment | credited to the borrower | Yes | No |
| Larkspur One-Point Permanent Buydown | none | none | none | credited to the borrower | Yes | No |
| Larkspur Two-Point Permanent Buydown | none | none | none | credited to the borrower | Yes | No |
| Larkspur Three-Point Permanent Buydown | none | none | none | credited to the borrower | Yes | No |

The three permanent products hold no subsidy after closing and have no subsidy draws; their entries for holding, drawing and first supported payment are none.

### The balance in figures (hypothetical)

A hypothetical Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown subsidy of $7,415.40 is held in the custodial account after closing. Three monthly draws of $408.70 each have been made with payments 1, 2 and 3, totalling $1,226.10. The buydown subsidy balance is $7,415.40 less $1,226.10, which is $6,189.30, and that is the amount not yet drawn or refunded.

### Questions the terms answer

- *Where does a temporary product's subsidy sit after closing?* In the custodial account.
- *From which payment is it drawn?* From the first payment, monthly with each payment.
- *Are the discount points of a permanent product refundable after closing?* No, for all three permanent products.
